subject: Theranos Edison blood testing device clinical accuracy claims
executive_summary: Theranos Edison device's claimed clinical accuracy is disproven by multiple independent studies and CMS reports, showing high error rates and sample rejection.
key_findings: Edison device rejected samples 2.2% and produced 12.2% out-of-range results, far exceeding industry standards.
CMS quality-control tests revealed 87% failure for hormone and 22% for PSA in 2015.
evidence_synthesis: Independent studies and CMS reports consistently demonstrate that the Edison device failed to deliver accurate results. The device rejected 2.2% of samples and produced 12.2% out-of-range results, compared to 0% rejection and 8.3%/7.5% out-of-range for Quest Diagnostics and LabCorp. CMS quality-control tests in 2015 showed 87% failure for a hormone and 22% for PSA, indicating highly unreliable performance. These findings collectively refute Theranos's clinical accuracy claims.
conflict_resolution_notes: All cited evidence consistently refutes the device's accuracy; no contradictory data identified.
